versions.changelog:
focus-toolkit 1.0.0 — Unified full-lifecycle focus workflow

- Integrates alarm, pomodoro timer, ambient sound generator, and analytics into one toolkit
- Session data persists across restarts for uninterrupted tracking
- Built-in cron support delivers reminders without blocking chat
- Entirely Python standard library—no external dependencies
- Supersedes natural-alarm, pomodoro-workflow, focus-soundscape, and attention-analytics (no further updates to individual versions)
